import numpy as np
def als(At_basis, G_basis, iters=200):
    A=np.column_stack(At_basis); G=np.column_stack(G_basis)
    g=np.ones(len(x))
    for _ in range(iters):
        # fit A-coeffs: dv = sum_k a_k t^k * g
        M=A*g[:,None]; a,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(M,dv_dt,rcond=None)
        At=A@a
        # fit G-coeffs: dv = At * (G@c)
        M2=G*At[:,None]; c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(M2,dv_dt,rcond=None)
        g=G@c
    pred=(A@a)*(G@c)
    return np.mean((pred-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt), a, c
